deviations.message: The grey opening on the top wall of room 0.06 (a single point in the dataset plan) is drawn as a bar about 3.6 m wide. It starts outside the west edge of the building, runs along all of 0.06's top wall and continues into room 0.01. It should be a small opening at its dataset position, roughly in the middle of 0.06's top wall. Check how the floorplan stage sizes openings that have no width or an unknown type.
